chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Do not leave your deceased alone, for Shaytan disturbs him within his body.

key_terms.الشَّيْطَانَ: Shaytan, the satanic being who causes harm or disturbance
key_terms.جَوْفِهِ: his inner cavity or interior of the body

ai.seo_question: Why should the deceased not be left alone according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that a deceased person should not be left alone. It indicates a concern for the state of the deceased immediately after death and reflects an aspect of funerary etiquette and attentiveness in relation to the dead.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.396 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Do not leave your deceased alone, for Shaytan may disturb them within their body."
